set(
    DROGULAR_CLI_GIT_REF
    "v${PROJECT_VERSION}"
    CACHE STRING
    "Git ref written into projects generated by the Drogular CLI"
)

add_executable(drogular_cli
    main.cpp
)

set_target_properties(drogular_cli PROPERTIES
    OUTPUT_NAME drogular
)

target_compile_features(drogular_cli
    PRIVATE
        cxx_std_20
)

target_compile_definitions(drogular_cli
    PRIVATE
        DROGULAR_CLI_VERSION="${PROJECT_VERSION}"
        DROGULAR_CLI_GIT_REF="${DROGULAR_CLI_GIT_REF}"
)

target_link_libraries(drogular_cli
    PRIVATE
        Drogular::project_generator
)

install(
    TARGETS drogular_cli
    RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}
)
